title.narrative: ISLAMIC UNIVERSITY OF IAIN SYARIF HIDAYATULLAH

description.narrative: THE PROJECT AIMS AT UPGRADING AND DEVELOPING THE IAIN IN JAKARTA INTO A FULL_FLEDG MODERN UNIVERSITY AND IT INCLUDES: ADDING 6 NEW FACULTIES IN GENERAL SCIENCES, EXPANDING AND UPGRADING THE EXISTING 5 DEPARTMENTS INTO FACULTIES, RESTRUCTURING MODERNISATION OF THE CURRICULUM AND TRAINING AND CAPACITY BUILDING OF STAFF.
